[SWS_DM_00959] Default value for DTC "aging counter down" if aging is not
allowed
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04190
⌈
If the element
DiagnosticTroubleCodeProps.aging
does not exist and the
DiagnosticExtendedDataRecordElement
is referred by
DiagnosticEdrDat-
aProviderMapping.extendedDataRecordElement
and
DiagnosticEdrDat-
aProviderMapping.dataProvider
is set to
DEM_AGINGCTR_DOWNCNT
, the DM
shall set the respective
extended data record
value to
DiagnosticAging.
threshold
if configured or ’255’ otherwise.
⌋
